				googletag.pubads().setTargeting('section', section);
				if (brandedSafetyTerms.length) {
					googletag.pubads().setTargeting('branded_safety', brandedSafetyTerms.slice(0, 15));
				}

				var immediate1x1Ids = [];
				var pubadsFinished = false;

				function displayImmediate1x1Now() {
					immediate1x1Ids.forEach(function (id) {
						if (document.getElementById(id)) {
							googletag.display(id);
						}

				}

				function immediate1x1Missing() {
					return immediate1x1Ids.some(function (id) {
						return !document.getElementById(id);
					});
				}

				function finishPubads() {
					if (pubadsFinished) {
						return;
					}
					pubadsFinished = true;

				googletag.pubads().enableLazyLoad({

					var slot = event.slot;
					if (!isFooterRefreshBlocked(slot) && slot.getTargeting(REFRESH_KEY).indexOf(REFRESH_VALUE) > -1) {
						setTimeout(function () {
							// A BYD pode aparecer depois de este refresh ter sido agendado.
							if (!isFooterRefreshBlocked(slot)) {

							}
						}, SECONDS_TO_WAIT_AFTER_VIEWABILITY * 1000);
					}
				});

				googletag.pubads().collapseEmptyDivs(true);

		function armGptQueue() {
			if (gptArmed) {

			gptArmed = true;
			var queued = gptBuffer.slice();

			if (googletag.cmd.push === gptBufferedPush) {

			function tick() {

				requestAnimationFrame(tick);

					googletag.pubads().setTargeting('branded_safety', brandedSafetyTerms.slice(0, 15));
				}

				var immediate1x1Ids = [];
				var pubadsFinished = false;

				function displayImmediate1x1Now() {
					immediate1x1Ids.forEach(function (id) {
						if (document.getElementById(id)) {
							googletag.display(id);

				function immediate1x1Missing() {
					return immediate1x1Ids.some(function (id) {

				function finishPubads() {
					if (pubadsFinished) {

					var slot = event.slot;
					if (!isFooterRefreshBlocked(slot) && slot.getTargeting(REFRESH_KEY).indexOf(REFRESH_VALUE) > -1) {

		function armGptQueue() {
			if (gptArmed) {
				return;
			}
			gptArmed = true;
			var queued = gptBuffer.slice();
			gptBuffer = [];
			if (googletag.cmd.push === gptBufferedPush) {
				googletag.cmd.push = gptNativePush;

		function scheduleGptQueue() {
			if (viewportIsSettled()) {
				armGptQueue();
				return;

			var tries = 0;
			function tick() {
				tries += 1;
				if (viewportIsSettled() || tries > 8) {
					armGptQueue();
					return;
				}
				requestAnimationFrame(tick);
			}
			requestAnimationFrame(tick);

		// Função principal de configuração do Google Ad Manager
		function configureAdManager() {
			if (adsInitialized) {
				return;
			}
			adsInitialized = true;

			googletag.cmd.push(function () {
				if (window.poderBydFooter) {
					window.poderBydFooter.init();
				}

				if (isMobileViewport()) {
					registerMobileSlots(pageContext);
				} else {
					registerDesktopSlots(pageContext);
				}

				googletag.pubads().setTargeting('url', window.location.pathname);
				googletag.pubads().setTargeting('pageContext', pageContext);
				googletag.pubads().setTargeting('device', isMobileViewport() ? 'mobile' : 'desktop');
				var section = (document.body && document.body.getAttribute('data-section')) || 'default';
				googletag.pubads().setTargeting('section', section);
				if (brandedSafetyTerms.length) {
					googletag.pubads().setTargeting('branded_safety', brandedSafetyTerms.slice(0, 15));
				}

				var immediate1x1Ids = [];
				var pubadsFinished = false;

				function displayImmediate1x1Now() {
					immediate1x1Ids.forEach(function (id) {
						if (document.getElementById(id)) {
							googletag.display(id);
						}
					});
				}

				function immediate1x1Missing() {
					return immediate1x1Ids.some(function (id) {
						return !document.getElementById(id);
					});
				}

				function finishPubads() {
					if (pubadsFinished) {
						return;
					}
					pubadsFinished = true;

				googletag.pubads().enableLazyLoad({
					fetchMarginPercent: 75,
					renderMarginPercent: 150,
					mobileScaling: 1.5
				});

				googletag.pubads().addEventListener('impressionViewable', function (event) {
					var slot = event.slot;
					if (!isFooterRefreshBlocked(slot) && slot.getTargeting(REFRESH_KEY).indexOf(REFRESH_VALUE) > -1) {
						setTimeout(function () {
							// A BYD pode aparecer depois de este refresh ter sido agendado.
							if (!isFooterRefreshBlocked(slot)) {
								googletag.pubads().refresh([slot]);
							}
						}, SECONDS_TO_WAIT_AFTER_VIEWABILITY * 1000);
					}
				});

				googletag.pubads().collapseEmptyDivs(true);
				googletag.enableServices();

				displayImmediate1x1Now();

				// Força display imediato dos slots de programática (sem lazy load)
				// Todos os slots programáticos devem ser exibidos imediatamente
				var programaticElementIds = [
					// Home Mobile
					'div-gpt-ad-1770043978745-0', // 300x250_programatica_home_mobile
					'div-gpt-ad-1770044575528-0', // 320x100_programatica_home_mobile

					'div-gpt-ad-1770058016232-0', // 300x600_programatica_home_desktop_2
					// Page Desktop

					'div-gpt-ad-1770061318249-0'  // 300x600_programatica_page_desktop_2
				];
				programaticElementIds.forEach(function (elementId) {
					var element = document.getElementById(elementId);
					if (element) {
						googletag.display(elementId);
					}
				});
				}

				if (immediate1x1Ids.length && immediate1x1Missing()) {
					var startImmediate1x1AndPubads = function () {
						googletag.cmd.push(function () {
							finishPubads();
						});
					};
					if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
						document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', startImmediate1x1AndPubads);
					} else {
						startImmediate1x1AndPubads();
					}
				} else {
					finishPubads();
				}
			});
		}

		var gptBuffer = [];
		var gptArmed = false;
		var gptNativePush = googletag.cmd.push.bind(googletag.cmd);

		function gptBufferedPush(fn) {
			gptBuffer.push(fn);
			return gptBuffer.length;
		}

		googletag.cmd.push = gptBufferedPush;

		function armGptQueue() {
			if (gptArmed) {
				return;
			}
			gptArmed = true;
			var queued = gptBuffer.slice();
			gptBuffer = [];
			if (googletag.cmd.push === gptBufferedPush) {
				googletag.cmd.push = gptNativePush;
			}
			queued.forEach(function (fn) {
				googletag.cmd.push(fn);
			});
		}

		function scheduleGptQueue() {
			if (viewportIsSettled()) {
				armGptQueue();
				return;
			}
			var tries = 0;
			function tick() {
				tries += 1;
				if (viewportIsSettled() || tries > 8) {
					armGptQueue();
					return;
				}
				requestAnimationFrame(tick);
			}
			requestAnimationFrame(tick);
			document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', armGptQueue);
		}

		configureAdManager();
		scheduleGptQueue();

<script>

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const dropdown = document.querySelector('.city-select');
  if (!dropdown) return;

  const button = dropdown.querySelector('.city-select__button');
  const label  = dropdown.querySelector('.city-select__label');
  const list   = dropdown.querySelector('.city-select__list');
  const items  = dropdown.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]');

  // abrir / fechar
  button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const expanded = button.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
    button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!expanded));
    list.classList.toggle('show');
  });

  items.forEach(item => {
    item.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const tab = item.dataset.tab;

      // Atualiza label
      label.textContent = item.textContent.trim();

      // Atualiza aria-selected
      items.forEach(i => i.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false'));
      item.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');

      // 🔥 ATIVA A TAB REAL
      const desktopTab = document.querySelector(
        `.tab-button[data-tab="${tab}"]`
      );
      if (desktopTab) {
        desktopTab.click();
      }

      // Fecha dropdown
      list.classList.remove('show');
      button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    });
  });

  // clique fora
  document.addEventListener('click', e => {
    if (!dropdown.contains(e.target)) {
      list.classList.remove('show');
      button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    }
  });
});

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  // === Tabs ===
  const tabButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-button');
  const tabContents = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content');

  tabButtons.forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', function() {
      const targetTab = this.getAttribute('data-tab');

      tabButtons.forEach(btn => {
        btn.classList.remove('active');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
      });
      tabContents.forEach(content => content.classList.remove('active'));

      this.classList.add('active');
      this.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
      const target = document.getElementById(targetTab);
      if (target) target.classList.add('active');
    });
  });

  // === Utilidades de data ===
  const MONTHS = { "jan":1,"fev":2,"mar":3,"abr":4,"mai":5,"jun":6,"jul":7,"ago":8,"set":9,"out":10,"nov":11,"dez":12 };
  const PT_WEEKDAYS = ["Domingo","Segunda-feira","Terça-feira","Quarta-feira","Quinta-feira","Sexta-feira","Sábado"];

  function toKey(day, monAbbr) {
    return (MONTHS[monAbbr] * 100) + day;
  }
  function weekdayName(year, day, monAbbr) {
    const m = MONTHS[monAbbr];
    const d = new Date(year, m - 1, day).getDay();
    return PT_WEEKDAYS[d];
  }

});

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const toggle = document.querySelector('.tabs-dropdown__toggle');
  const list = document.querySelector('.tabs-dropdown__list');
  const label = document.querySelector('.tabs-dropdown__label');
  const items = list.querySelectorAll('li');

  toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const expanded = toggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!expanded));
    list.classList.toggle('show');
  });

  items.forEach(item => {
    item.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const tab = item.dataset.tab;

      // Atualiza label
      label.textContent = item.textContent;

      // Simula clique no tab desktop
      const desktopTab = document.querySelector(`.tab-button[data-tab="${tab}"]`);
      if (desktopTab) desktopTab.click();

      list.classList.remove('show');
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    });
  });

  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (!toggle.contains(e.target) && !list.contains(e.target)) {
      list.classList.remove('show');
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    }

		// Função principal de configuração do Google Ad Manager
		function configureAdManager() {
			if (adsInitialized) {
				return;
			}
			adsInitialized = true;

			googletag.cmd.push(function () {
				if (window.poderBydFooter) {
					window.poderBydFooter.init();
				}

				if (isMobileViewport()) {
					registerMobileSlots(pageContext);
				} else {
					registerDesktopSlots(pageContext);
				}

				googletag.pubads().setTargeting('url', window.location.pathname);
				googletag.pubads().setTargeting('pageContext', pageContext);
				googletag.pubads().setTargeting('device', isMobileViewport() ? 'mobile' : 'desktop');
				var section = (document.body && document.body.getAttribute('data-section')) || 'default';
				googletag.pubads().setTargeting('section', section);
				if (brandedSafetyTerms.length) {
					googletag.pubads().setTargeting('branded_safety', brandedSafetyTerms.slice(0, 15));
				}

				var immediate1x1Ids = [];
				var pubadsFinished = false;

				function displayImmediate1x1Now() {
					immediate1x1Ids.forEach(function (id) {
						if (document.getElementById(id)) {
							googletag.display(id);
						}
					});
				}

				function immediate1x1Missing() {
					return immediate1x1Ids.some(function (id) {
						return !document.getElementById(id);
					});
				}

				function finishPubads() {
					if (pubadsFinished) {
						return;
					}
					pubadsFinished = true;

				googletag.pubads().enableLazyLoad({
					fetchMarginPercent: 75,
					renderMarginPercent: 150,
					mobileScaling: 1.5
				});

				googletag.pubads().addEventListener('impressionViewable', function (event) {
					var slot = event.slot;
					if (!isFooterRefreshBlocked(slot) && slot.getTargeting(REFRESH_KEY).indexOf(REFRESH_VALUE) > -1) {
						setTimeout(function () {
							// A BYD pode aparecer depois de este refresh ter sido agendado.
							if (!isFooterRefreshBlocked(slot)) {
								googletag.pubads().refresh([slot]);
							}
						}, SECONDS_TO_WAIT_AFTER_VIEWABILITY * 1000);
					}
				});

				googletag.pubads().collapseEmptyDivs(true);
				googletag.enableServices();

				displayImmediate1x1Now();

				// Força display imediato dos slots de programática (sem lazy load)
				// Todos os slots programáticos devem ser exibidos imediatamente
				var programaticElementIds = [
					// Home Mobile
					'div-gpt-ad-1770043978745-0', // 300x250_programatica_home_mobile
					'div-gpt-ad-1770044575528-0', // 320x100_programatica_home_mobile
					// Single Mobile (opcional, ACF)
										// Page Mobile
					'div-gpt-ad-1770056321865-0', // 300x250_programatica_page_mobile
					'div-gpt-ad-1770057244689-0', // 320x100_programatica_page_mobile
					// Home Desktop
					'div-gpt-ad-1770057723202-0', // 300x250_programatica_home_desktop
					'div-gpt-ad-1770058016232-0', // 300x600_programatica_home_desktop_2
					// Page Desktop
					'div-gpt-ad-1770061230068-0', // 300x250_programatica_page_desktop
					'div-gpt-ad-1770061318249-0'  // 300x600_programatica_page_desktop_2
				];
				programaticElementIds.forEach(function (elementId) {
					var element = document.getElementById(elementId);
					if (element) {
						googletag.display(elementId);
					}
				});
				}

				if (immediate1x1Ids.length && immediate1x1Missing()) {
					var startImmediate1x1AndPubads = function () {
						googletag.cmd.push(function () {
							finishPubads();
						});
					};
					if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
						document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', startImmediate1x1AndPubads);
					} else {
						startImmediate1x1AndPubads();
					}
				} else {
					finishPubads();
				}
			});
		}

		var gptBuffer = [];
		var gptArmed = false;
		var gptNativePush = googletag.cmd.push.bind(googletag.cmd);

		function gptBufferedPush(fn) {
			gptBuffer.push(fn);
			return gptBuffer.length;
		}

		googletag.cmd.push = gptBufferedPush;

		function armGptQueue() {
			if (gptArmed) {
				return;
			}
			gptArmed = true;
			var queued = gptBuffer.slice();
			gptBuffer = [];
			if (googletag.cmd.push === gptBufferedPush) {
				googletag.cmd.push = gptNativePush;
			}
			queued.forEach(function (fn) {
				googletag.cmd.push(fn);
			});
		}

		function scheduleGptQueue() {
			if (viewportIsSettled()) {
				armGptQueue();
				return;
			}
			var tries = 0;
			function tick() {
				tries += 1;
				if (viewportIsSettled() || tries > 8) {
					armGptQueue();
					return;
				}
				requestAnimationFrame(tick);
			}
			requestAnimationFrame(tick);
			document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', armGptQueue);
		}

		configureAdManager();
		scheduleGptQueue();
			}) ();

		// Função principal de configuração do Google Ad Manager
		function configureAdManager() {
			if (adsInitialized) {
				return;
			}
			adsInitialized = true;

			googletag.cmd.push(function () {
				if (window.poderBydFooter) {
					window.poderBydFooter.init();
				}

				if (isMobileViewport()) {
					registerMobileSlots(pageContext);
				} else {
					registerDesktopSlots(pageContext);
				}

				googletag.pubads().setTargeting('url', window.location.pathname);
				googletag.pubads().setTargeting('pageContext', pageContext);
				googletag.pubads().setTargeting('device', isMobileViewport() ? 'mobile' : 'desktop');
				var section = (document.body && document.body.getAttribute('data-section')) || 'default';
				googletag.pubads().setTargeting('section', section);
				if (brandedSafetyTerms.length) {
					googletag.pubads().setTargeting('branded_safety', brandedSafetyTerms.slice(0, 15));
				}

				var immediate1x1Ids = [];
				var pubadsFinished = false;

				function displayImmediate1x1Now() {
					immediate1x1Ids.forEach(function (id) {
						if (document.getElementById(id)) {
							googletag.display(id);
						}
					});
				}

				function immediate1x1Missing() {
					return immediate1x1Ids.some(function (id) {
						return !document.getElementById(id);
					});
				}

				function finishPubads() {
					if (pubadsFinished) {
						return;
					}
					pubadsFinished = true;

				googletag.pubads().enableLazyLoad({
					fetchMarginPercent: 75,
					renderMarginPercent: 150,
					mobileScaling: 1.5
				});

				googletag.pubads().addEventListener('impressionViewable', function (event) {
					var slot = event.slot;
					if (!isFooterRefreshBlocked(slot) && slot.getTargeting(REFRESH_KEY).indexOf(REFRESH_VALUE) > -1) {
						setTimeout(function () {
							// A BYD pode aparecer depois de este refresh ter sido agendado.
							if (!isFooterRefreshBlocked(slot)) {
								googletag.pubads().refresh([slot]);
							}
						}, SECONDS_TO_WAIT_AFTER_VIEWABILITY * 1000);
					}
				});

				googletag.pubads().collapseEmptyDivs(true);
				googletag.enableServices();

				displayImmediate1x1Now();

				// Força display imediato dos slots de programática (sem lazy load)
				// Todos os slots programáticos devem ser exibidos imediatamente
				var programaticElementIds = [
					// Home Mobile
					'div-gpt-ad-1770043978745-0', // 300x250_programatica_home_mobile
					'div-gpt-ad-1770044575528-0', // 320x100_programatica_home_mobile
					// Single Mobile (opcional, ACF)
										// Page Mobile
					'div-gpt-ad-1770056321865-0', // 300x250_programatica_page_mobile
					'div-gpt-ad-1770057244689-0', // 320x100_programatica_page_mobile
					// Home Desktop
					'div-gpt-ad-1770057723202-0', // 300x250_programatica_home_desktop
					'div-gpt-ad-1770058016232-0', // 300x600_programatica_home_desktop_2
					// Page Desktop
					'div-gpt-ad-1770061230068-0', // 300x250_programatica_page_desktop
					'div-gpt-ad-1770061318249-0'  // 300x600_programatica_page_desktop_2
				];
				programaticElementIds.forEach(function (elementId) {
					var element = document.getElementById(elementId);
					if (element) {
						googletag.display(elementId);
					}
				});
				}

				if (immediate1x1Ids.length && immediate1x1Missing()) {
					var startImmediate1x1AndPubads = function () {
						googletag.cmd.push(function () {
							finishPubads();
						});
					};
					if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
						document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', startImmediate1x1AndPubads);
					} else {
						startImmediate1x1AndPubads();
					}
				} else {
					finishPubads();
				}
			});
		}

		var gptBuffer = [];
		var gptArmed = false;
		var gptNativePush = googletag.cmd.push.bind(googletag.cmd);

		function gptBufferedPush(fn) {
			gptBuffer.push(fn);
			return gptBuffer.length;
		}

		googletag.cmd.push = gptBufferedPush;

		function armGptQueue() {
			if (gptArmed) {
				return;
			}
			gptArmed = true;
			var queued = gptBuffer.slice();
			gptBuffer = [];
			if (googletag.cmd.push === gptBufferedPush) {
				googletag.cmd.push = gptNativePush;
			}
			queued.forEach(function (fn) {
				googletag.cmd.push(fn);

	function initFixedListStopAtFooter() {
		var $footer = $('.footer').first();
		if (!$footer.length) return;

		var isMobile = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 850px)').matches;

			var $mainUl = $box.children('ul').first();
			if (!$mainUl.length) return;

			boxes.push({ $box: $box, $mainUl: $mainUl });
		});

		if (!boxes.length) return;

		var rafId = 0;

				rafId = 0;
				update();

		function computeThreshold(box) {
			// Para medir o "top" correto, garante que o UL está em modo fixed.
			var wasInactive = box.$box.hasClass('inactive');
			if (wasInactive) box.$box.removeClass('inactive');

			var rect = box.$mainUl[0].getBoundingClientRect();
			var topPx = rect.top;
			var heightPx = rect.height;

			var footerTopDoc = $footer.offset().top;
			var margin = 20;

			// Quando scrollY + topPx + heightPx + margin >= footerTopDoc, a lista encostaria no footer.
			return footerTopDoc - topPx - heightPx - margin;
		}

			var mobileNow = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 850px)').matches;
			if (mobileNow) {
